Caution honestly reflected: the board may be thin in your area — verify jobs exist locally before committing time.

Shops submitted between the 1st and 15th will be paid around the last day of that month. Shops submitted between the 16th and 31st will be paid around the 15th of the following month.

steps: Sign up free on shoppersview.com (PayPal email must match signup email)
Browse job board / get email or Shop Notifier app alerts
Complete the shop (~30 min typical) per brief
Paid via PayPal in two cycles: mid-month shops ~month-end; late-month shops ~15th next month
timing: PayPal, twice-monthly cycle: shops submitted 1st-15th paid around the last day of the month; 16th-31st paid around the 15th of the following month.

repeatable.cadence: Grab shops one at a time from the job board — each approved shop pays $10–$40 — and take new ones whenever they post in your area.

maximize: Your PayPal email must exactly match your signup email or you will not get paid — fix that before your first shop. The board is thin in some areas, so check often and grab good shops fast. Refer a friend for the $5 bonus when they finish a shop.
who_pays: Shoppers' View — a Grand Rapids, Michigan mystery-shopping company (est. 1993, MSPA Americas member) — pays you via PayPal for each approved shop.
who_qualifies: 18+, US or Canada, working as an independent contractor. No experience required, but you need a sharp eye for detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to meet deadlines. You need a PayPal account whose email exactly matches your signup email, or you risk not being paid.
work_available: You browse an online job board of current shops plus email and app alerts. Be honest with yourself: the board can be thin — if nothing is listed in your area, either other shoppers already took the shops or there simply are none right now, and some shoppers found zero jobs in their state. Check the board often; the company says it adds new clients regularly.
what_gets_accepted: You get paid only for accepted reports. Stay in character and keep the shop completely confidential, follow the scenario exactly, hit the specific deadline given for each assignment, and submit a detailed, accurate report on the service and products. Payments and reimbursements for each shop are spelled out on the job board before you accept.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Signing up is free and Shoppers' View states it never charges shoppers for job placements. Unpaid time: browsing the board, traveling to shop locations, doing the shop itself (typically ~30 minutes), and writing up the report. Restaurant shops may reimburse your meal plus a guest's meal.
when_cash_arrives: Paid via PayPal in two cycles: shops submitted between the 1st and 15th are paid around the last day of that month; shops submitted between the 16th and 31st are paid around the 15th of the following month.
